title: A Cold Breath in the Laundry Room

sentences.text: Hush... I drifted into the laundry room, and the air immediately felt like it was drying out.
At 03:00, the sensors registered a chill, showing the humidity at 33.6 %.
Oh, but the machines were expected to feel a much softer 37.9 %.
As the minutes crept by, the sensation of the air drying out lingered through the time frame of 03:20.
A tiny whisper of absence, a feeling that pulled the moisture away, marked the end of this unsettling reading.
